development.group_definition: 160 geometry-level spatial groups; four users per geometry; no user reuse; minimum group-center distance 10 m and minimum intra-geometry user distance 20 m
development.independence_basis: Development-only ASU Campus ray-tracing set reused from the v9-v12 development workflow; no independent-test claim is made for this dataset
development.channel_normalization: none; absolute DeepMIMO channel scale retained
cautions: This is development data and must not be reported as an independent V13 test.
Disjoint user indices and spatial separation do not prove independent channel episodes.

test.group_definition: 40 fixed 15 m spatial grid cells; four geometries per cell; four users per geometry; 640 unique UEs without reuse
test.independence_basis: New York city_0_newyork_3p5 ray-tracing scenario is distinct from the ASU Campus development scenario; selection and channel generation occurred only after the V13 CP02 policy lock
test.channel_normalization: none; absolute DeepMIMO complex channel scale retained
cautions: Different scenarios and a post-lock selection support separation but do not prove statistical independence.
The finite ZF/RZF candidate audit is not global beamforming optimality.
This test dataset must not be used to retune the locked V13 policy.
